import "strings"
from(bucket: "GMP_sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_measurements" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with
       device: strings.split(v: r.topic, t: "/")[1],
       channel: strings.split(v: r.topic, t: "/")[4] }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "uptime") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "wifi_signal") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "boot_count") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "calibration") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "mac_address") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "ip_address") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "ssid") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "version") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "last_calibrated") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "compliance_note") and not strings.containsStr(v: r.channel, substr: "heartbeat_counter"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with age_s: (int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000 }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.age_s <= 900)
  |> group()
  |> count(column: "device")
